name: Windsurf
notes: Project skills moved to .devin/skills; the legacy .windsurf/skills is still read. Whether Cascade also reads ~/.agents/skills was not confirmed in the official docs, so the installer uses Windsurf's own folder.
prerequisites: Python 3.10+ and Chromium for the engine
